manifest.name: gdn-fp8-qkv-z-out-q4k-mlp-q4k
manifest.description: The FP8 recurrent recipe with MLP Q4_K after layer 0 (gdn-fp8-mlp-q4k-skip0, gdn-fp8-mlp-q4k-zo-deep-q4k), with every recurrent out projection after layer 0 moved to Q4_K. FP8 stays where it protects the recurrent state: qkv at every depth and z in layers 0-31, as in the shallow-z finding of gdn-fp8-qkv-all-zo-split; z in layers 32-63 is Q4_K as in gdn-fp8-mlp-q4k-zo-deep-q4k. The shallow out projections were the remaining FP8 units whose 8 bits buy little fidelity, so turning them to Q4_K cuts decode traffic and peak memory below every FP8 recipe on the frontier, at a small drift cost. Layer 0 and attention stay as they are, so the batched-prefill paths stay on. lm_head is stored BF16, so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once from the original weights.
